data.name: Epaphras
data.long_meaning: Epaphras was a loyal companion to the Apostle Paul and a faithful servant of Christ. He was also one of the founders of the church in Colossae.
data.spiritual_meaning: He represents the beauty of selfless love and unwavering faith.
data.numerology_meaning: Epaphras is a name that represents creativity, self-expression, and personal growth. It is also a name that suggests a deep connection to spirituality and a strong desire to help others.

in_hebrew.name: אפאפרס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אפאפרס נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'אפאפרין', שפירושה 'מלאך' או 'שליח'. השם משויך לאפאפרס, משרתו של פאולוס ומיסיונר נוצרי מוקדם, המוזכר ב-קולוסים 1:7 ו-פילימון 23.

in_greek.name: Ἐπαφρᾶς
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Ἐπαφρᾶς ἐκ τοῦ ἑλληνιστικοῦ ὀνόματος, ῥήματος ἄπτω, σηματοδοτοῦντος 'ἀπόστολον' ἢ 'ἄγγελον'. Ὁ Ἐπαφρᾶς ἦν σύνεργος τοῦ Παύλου καὶ πρωτομυστήριος τῆς Χριστιανικῆς Οἰκονομίας, παρ' ᾧ ἀναφέρεται εἰς Κολοσσαεῖς 1:7 καὶ Φιλήμονα 23.

in_latin.name: Epaphras
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Epaphras is derived from the Greek term 'Epaphras', meaning 'angel' or 'messenger'. Epaphras was a companion of Paul and an early Christian missionary mentioned in Colossians 1:7 and Philemon 23.

in_english.name: Epaphras
in_english.meaning: a messenger or angel of God in Christian tradition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Epaphras originates from Greek roots, signifying a messenger, angel, or apostle. In Christian tradition, Epaphras was a companion of Apostle Paul and an early Christian missionary mentioned in the New Testament, specifically in Colossians 1:7 and Philemon 23. The name symbolizes spiritual guidance, evangelism, and dedication to spreading the Christian faith.

biblical_reference.note: Epaphras is mentioned as a faithful servant and fellow worker in spreading the gospel.

data.cultural_impact: Epaphras is a name rooted in early Christian history, symbolizing dedication, loyalty, and leadership. As a native of Colossae, he played a significant role in spreading the gospel to his community and establishing a thriving church there. Today, the name continues to resonate with believers and serves as a reminder of the importance of sharing one's faith and building strong local communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Epaphras represents the commitment and perseverance of an early Christian leader. In Colossians 1:7, Paul commends Epaphras for his steadfastness in the faith and his labor for the saints. By emulating his example, we can strive to deepen our spiritual connection with God and serve as witnesses to His love and grace in our own communities. Additionally, the fact that Epaphras was a founder and leader of a church speaks to the importance of community and fellowship in our spiritual journey.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Epaphras is mentioned in the New Testament as a companion of Paul the Apostle. The name Epaphras carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Epaphras is associated with the early Christian church in Colossae, Asia Minor.

trends: increasing popularity as a given name in some Christian communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Epaphras remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Peter Epaphras from Athens, Greece embodies the meaning of Epaphras - "Beloved". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Epaphras, meaning "enlightened by God" or "shining forth from God," embodies the spiritual illumination and radiance that comes from a deep connection with Christ. His name is a reminder of the transformative power of faith and the divine light within us all.
